content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-463. - I.P.M.C. Section 103.2, Appointment.
content.summary:
Section 103.2. Appointment,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"The building official shall be appointed by the chief appointing authority of this
                  jurisdiction."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
